body:
Your Office Space is an outsourced property team. We partner with businesses to take the strain out of growing. Furniture projects are the Furnish It part of that work, with online ordering through Your Office Furniture.

## Start with the workplace, then choose the furniture

For an office furniture Newcastle brief, record the people, rooms, retained items, business suburb and timing. A measured plan helps turn those requirements into a product list.

[Discuss a furniture project with YOS](/furniture) or [shop the current Your Office Furniture range](https://www.yourofficefurniture.com.au).

## Compare the same scope

- Confirm each product’s size, finish, quantity and included components.
- Separate product cost, delivery, assembly, installation and packaging removal.
- Confirm site access, loading, stairs or lifts and building booking requirements.
- Check availability and timing for the actual order.
- Record any proposed substitutions before accepting a quote.
- Check whether the furniture can suit the next stage of the business.

## What YOS and Your Office Furniture do

YOS helps organise the project brief and furniture requirements. Your Office Furniture provides the online shopping route. A coordinated furniture project can include product selection, supply and installation within an agreed scope. Product availability, address eligibility, timing and any installation service are confirmed for the order.

## Real projects to explore

[Recovery Station’s premises search](/case-studies/recovery-station-east-maitland-tenant-representation) shows the importance of connecting the property brief with the workplace requirements.

[The Cardiff reception makeover](/case-studies/cardiff-reception-makeover-office-furniture-newcastle) shows furniture supplied and installed by Your Office Furniture for Total Fitouts Newcastle.

[The Dynamic Business Technologies boardroom project](/case-studies/dbt-boardroom-refresh) covers the table, chairs and joinery scope at Warners Bay.

## Prepare a useful request

Send the floor plan if available, business suburb, quantities, preferred finishes, access details and required timing. List what is essential separately from what can change.

[Prepare a furniture quote brief](/resources/furniture-quote#furniture-quote-form).

## Common questions

### How should I compare office furniture companies in Newcastle?

Compare the same product specifications, quantities and installed scope. Check delivery access, availability, timing, exclusions and any proposed substitutions before accepting a quote.

### Can I buy furniture without a full office fitout?

Yes. Browse the Your Office Furniture online store or discuss a separately agreed furniture project with YOS. A construction project is not required to make a furniture enquiry.
